name: folio
description: Magazine-style presentation skill that turns structured content into editable decks across HTML, PPTX, PDF, Figma, and IDML.
release_highlights: Added a ten-page editorial sample and three separate 16:9 layout studies with image credits.
Clarified that wireframe guides do not carry into finished layouts without an explicit design role.

Require a cached update check at the start of each Folio task; upgrades still require user confirmation.
